plugins.name: cad-to-facts
plugins.description: Extracts traceable STEP and DWG/DXF evidence, declared AP242 semantic PMI and model/drawing BOMs; reviews requirements, resolves spatial occurrence references, answers bounded model questions, exports target-isolated SVG views, and verifies external changes. DWG requires optional ODA. Deterministic and local; VLM inference is not enabled.
